edges.label: Wayne State clinician authored the AAWSAP human-effects reference document
edges.note: Green, while a Wayne State professor, wrote the Defense Intelligence Reference Document 'Anomalous Acute and Subacute Field Effects on Human and Biological Tissues' for the DIA-funded AAWSAP contract; DIA released it with the other DIRDs in 2022. Tier 2 because the work was Green's, commissioned through BAASS, not a Wayne State institutional contract.
